name: Split-flap Board
description: A split-flap departure board whose flaps fall through a few characters to each new letter, rippling across the columns.

props.name: text
props.description: Text to show. It is uppercased and word-wrapped to the board, and \n starts a new row. Screen readers get it as written, one paragraph per line.

props.name: rows
props.description: Number of rows. Text beyond the last row is cut off.

props.name: cols
props.description: Flaps per row. The board fills its container's width and the flaps scale to fit.

props.name: duration
props.description: Longest time in milliseconds a flap takes to reach its new character. Each flip is a sixth of it. Columns start 26ms apart, so the change ripples across. Under reduced motion, and while the board is off screen, the new text shows at once.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a soft synthesised clack for each flip. The browser only allows sound after the visitor has interacted with the page.

props.name: accent
props.description: Words matching this are shown in camellia. A string matches without regard to case; a match inside a word marks the whole word.

props.name: charset
props.description: The order of characters on each flap. A flap passes through the few characters before its target in this order.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the board's housing. Other div props are passed through.
